text: EUS-guided FNA of pancreatic head mass. DIAGNOSIS: Adenocarcinoma, pancreatic ductal type, moderately to poorly differentiated. Immunohistochemistry: CK7 positive, CK20 positive, CA 19-9 positive, CDX2 negative (excluding metastatic colorectal origin). Molecular/Genetic Testing: BRCA2 germline mutation detected (c.6174delT). KRAS mutation: G12D (somatic). TP53 mutation: Present. Microsatellite stability: MSS. PD-L1: <1%. COMMENT: Pathologic findings consistent with primary pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma. Germline BRCA2 mutation identified - patient is candidate for platinum-based chemotherapy and PARP inhibitor maintenance therapy. Family members should be offered genetic counseling. Recommend referral to genetics.
